Name: More Kinds of Tea
Author: theimmortalcrab
Description:
This mod is still in testing. I haven't gotten too far into testing it since the save file I used is in the winter. Please report any bugs here. 

Installation Instructions:
1. Download Mod
2. Unzip File 
3. Move File to Stardew Valley Mod Folder
4. Enjoy! 

(Please note that if you have More Recipes by PPJA, the black tea and oolong tea from my mod will not appear. I am working on adding other kinds of tea that hopefully won't overlap with other mods.
*I have discovered something new: you can buy black and oolong tea from my mod at the Saloon, but you will still get the errors message from SMAPI. I don't know why that is, so please let me know if you run into bugs.)

Changelog:
Version 0.1.1: Adds herbal, sunflower, sweet pea, and fairy rose tea to the game. 
Version 0.1.2: Adds dandelion tea to the game. Fixed error with herbal, sunflower, sweet pea, and fairy rose tea.
[b]
Warning: I used the vanilla color palette for the flower teas, so it will appear a little bright[/b]
